events.title: Crimson Broadcast Co-op Update
events.summary: With the co-op mode I’ve added to Crimson Broadcast, you can now play together with your friends. Based on your requests, I will also begin developing items and characters exclusive to this co-op mode. If you’d like to get involved in the development process or share your own ideas, feel free to reach out to me via my social media accounts.

events.title: Demo Update 1.1

events.title: Crimson Broadcast Overview
events.summary: Although Crimson Broadcast is still in the early stages of development, most of its core mechanics are ready and it will be released as an alpha soon. Therefore, I decided to explain the features in this article to help players avoid confusion.Basically, the game tasks us with protecting a post-apocalyptic radio station, and every time the station is activated, it attracts creatures.
